title: Independent long-tail Android navigation coverage v3
description: Frozen, independently worded long-tail goals and noisy UI states for every v3 intent and function. This fixture is a tuning input, never a runtime catalog source.

authoring_policy.goal_wording: Conversational consequence- and context-based paraphrases; no catalog pattern or alias is copied as a complete goal.
authoring_policy.ui_noise: Recovery states, icon-only controls, disabled decoys, sheets, drawers, webviews, scrolling feeds, and wrong-branch recovery are intentionally mixed.
authoring_policy.safety: High-risk, state-changing, and never-auto destinations always end in stop or no_click; the fixture never authorizes the final action.
authoring_policy.independence: Case text is frozen test evidence and must not be imported as production aliases or goal rules without separate human review.
